subject.title: fix(agents): bound model catalog JSON response reads for bedrock-mantle and huggingface

question: Should maintainers keep this PR as the HuggingFace landing path after dropping Mantle, or close it in favor of the clean HuggingFace-only https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97743?
rationale: Both options can solve the remaining HuggingFace gap, but choosing the canonical landing branch is maintainer coordination rather than a code-only judgment.

options.title: Refresh This PR To HuggingFace Only
options.body: Ask the contributor to drop all Mantle production/test edits and keep this PR focused on the remaining HuggingFace bounded-reader change.

options.title: Use The Clean HuggingFace PR
options.body: Close or pause this combined branch and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97743 as the proof-positive HuggingFace-only landing path.

options.title: Wait For First Clean Branch
options.body: Keep both HuggingFace candidates open until one branch is conflict-free and accepted by maintainers.

recommendation.title: Refresh This PR To HuggingFace Only
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to drop all Mantle production/test edits and keep this PR focused on the remaining HuggingFace bounded-reader change.
